summary: Novel-command parsers read AppTweak's {"result": {"<app id>": ...}} envelope (rank-fanout, track, paid-organic-gap, metadata-diff, reviews sentiment, credits status); rank lookups send metrics=rank and stay within 5 keywords per request; credits status adds additional credits to the monthly balance.
reason: AppTweak never returns content/data/results keys. The earlier parsers returned empty results, and metadata-diff reported every field as unchanged. Verified against captured live responses; envelope_test.go covers each shape.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli passes; each novel command returned real data live.
